# Scandics vd om kvartalet – experten tror på nya rekord

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon, 10 November 2026. The market tone is broadly positive. Stockholm is near all-time highs after a strong Wall Street session, and the guests point to a strong but choppy Swedish report season. The AI trade is under pressure from regulation after the US election and data-center politics. Guest Stefan Olofsson says his fund is positioned for further gains, with about 70% in equities against a roughly 64% average since 2009. Both guests are clearly bullish on Nordic banks because of low valuations, rising rates and AI cost savings. Handelsbanken is the top pick. Scandic's Q3 report gets a positive review. Munters' CMD tomorrow is flagged as a key event to watch. Real estate is still viewed with skepticism, and Joe Tracy urges diversification away from AI risk.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SHOT — Scandic Hotels | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest Stefan holds a large position. Strong Q3 margins, low valuation, good cash flow and dividend, possible buybacks. Dalata adds growth.

#### Reasoning

Guest Stefan Olofsson's fund holds Scandic as a large position. Q3 beat on earnings with adj. EBITDA +20% and net cash flow +60% YTD. Sweden is strong and Finland may be turning; Finland is about 22% of revenue. He calls the stock very cheaply valued with good cash flow and dividends, and expects buybacks unless there is another Dalata-type deal. The Dalata acquisition gives growth outside the Nordics but still has to deliver. Joe Tracy is also positive on Nordic consumer and travel.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Dalata integration fails to deliver outside the Nordics
- if Finland stays weak
- if results again miss analyst expectations

> *"Bolaget är väldigt lågt värderat. Det är väl deltagare runt 12-10 på 27-28. Och har bra cashflow och bra utdelning."*

---

### 🟢 SHB-A — Handelsbanken | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Both guests call it the safe bank pick and one of the best in the world. Estimates could surprise positively. Joe Tracy works there.

#### Reasoning

The guests are bullish on Nordic banks overall: P/E about 10 against about 19 for the market, a rerating to 15 seen as reasonable, rising rates widening net interest income, AI-driven cost savings, and value stocks rallying into the dividend season. Handelsbanken is singled out as the steady, safe pick. Stefan thinks earnings can beat estimates of around 11. Note that Joe Tracy works at Handelsbanken, so there is a possible bias.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rate hikes reverse
- if Nordic economy weakens
- if earnings miss estimates

> *"Säkert bank, det är Handelsbanken. Jag var Handelsbanken, absolut. En av de bästa i världen."*

---

### 🟢 NDA-SE — Nordea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Cheapest bank at P/E about 10. Money-laundering matter resolved. Guests recommend owning Nordic banks.

#### Reasoning

Nordic banks are seen as undervalued with a falling risk premium. Rising rates are expected to boost net interest income and AI to cut costs. For Nordea specifically, the money-laundering fine of SEK 9.7bn was already provisioned and its resolution is described as positive. The guests suggest owning several banks on a five-year horizon.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall
- if consumer credit deteriorates

> *"Vi har ett p/e-tal runt 10 på Nordea."*

---

### 🟢 SWED-A — Swedbank | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Most rate-sensitive bank, and rates are rising. 'Swedbank kan du äga.'

#### Reasoning

Part of the guests' broad buy-Nordic-banks view. It is the most rate-sensitive bank while rates are heading up, which should benefit net interest income through low deposit rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rate cycle reverses
- if housing/lending volumes weaken

> *"Swedbank kan du äga, så bankerna överhuvudtaget. Jag tycker absolut att du ska äga bankerna i Skandinavien."*

---

### 🟠 MTRS — Munters | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

CMD tomorrow with a new CEO. Strong backlog, but data-center regulation and margin risk. Guests are positive but want to hear guidance.

#### Reasoning

Joe Tracy says he is positive on Munters and its data-center exposure over time, but flags US Democratic regulation of data centers from around 2028, Nordic grid constraints and margin questions. The stock is down more than 20% YTD. Tomorrow's CMD and the new CEO's guidance are the key catalyst to monitor.

#### Sell Triggers

- if CMD guidance signals order slowdown from 2028
- if margins guided lower
- if data-center regulation tightens

> *"Sen tror jag att vi ska ha koll på Monters imorgon på CMD. Vi är positiva till Monters."*

---

### ⛔ CIBUS — Cibus | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Stefan's fund sold out of Cibus during the year and remains skeptical of real estate, preferring banks.

#### Reasoning

The guest has long been skeptical of real estate and was right. The sector does not benefit from higher rates and lettings look weak. He prefers banks over property.

#### Sell Triggers

- if long rates stabilize/fall making property attractive again

> *"Cibus hade vi kvar som sist, de har vi sålt under året i flera omgångar."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Jensen Huang/China probe headline risk. A further fall could be a buying opportunity, and it is cheap compared with AMD.

#### Reasoning

Joe Tracy flags headline risk around Jensen Huang and a reopened China probe. He also notes a low valuation compared with AMD and that the stock is down YTD, so a dip might be a buy. This is speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if probe escalates or leadership change
- if semiconductor downtrend persists

> *"Om aktien går ner kan det vara köpläge istället."*

---
